name: poseit-promo
description: Poseit promo film (vertical 1080x1920, 30 fps), built in Remotion from the app's own pose data

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-shapes.ts && npm run -s check-live
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Promo out/promo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.draft: remotion render src/index.ts Promo out/draft.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 22 --scale 0.5
scripts.check-live: esbuild scripts/export-live.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/export-live.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild scripts/check-live.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/check-live.mjs --log-level=warning && node out/check-live.mjs
